{"code": "cursos_lib_content = '''"""
Librería común para generar los cursos de Manos Abiertas.
Plantilla docx con paleta cálida, estilos consistentes y helpers reutilizables.
"""
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Cm, RGBColor, Inches, Emu
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_LINE_SPACING, WD_BREAK
from docx.enum.table import WD_ALIGN_VERTICAL, WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
import copy

# ============================================================
# Paleta Manos Abiertas — tono cálido comunitario
# ============================================================
PALETA = {
    "primario":    "C75B3C",  # terracota (color principal Manos Abiertas)
    "secundario":  "6B7A3A",  # verde oliva (apoyo)
    "acento":      "D9A441",  # ámbar dorado (highlights)
    "fondo":       "FAF3E7",  # crema claro (cajas)
    "fondo_oscuro":"2B2A28",  # carbón (texto fuerte)
    "texto":       "1F1B16",  # marrón oscuro (cuerpo)
    "texto_claro": "5C544A",  # gris cálido (metadata)
    "borde":       "D8C7A8",  # beige borde (cajas suaves)
    "blanco":      "FFFFFF",
    "pista":       "EFE3CC",  # crema oscuro (fondo dora)
    "aviso":       "F4D9CE",  # melocotón claro (fondo error)
}

# ============================================================
# Helpers de bajo nivel (XML)
# ============================================================
def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex):
    """Aplica color de fondo a una celda."""
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color_hex)
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    tc_pr.append(shd)

def set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex="000000", size="4"):
    """Aplica bordes a una celda."""
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tc_borders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
    for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
        border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
        border.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        border.set(qn("w:sz"), size)
        border.set(qn("w:color"), color_hex)
        tc_borders.append(border)
    tc_pr.append(tc_borders)

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    """Configura espaciado de párrafo."""
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

# ============================================================
# Helpers de contenido
# ============================================================
def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    """Añade un título con estilo consistente."""
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    elif level == 3:
        run.font.size = Pt(12)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=120, after=60)
    
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    """Añade párrafo de texto."""
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    """Añade un bloque de prompt con estilo visual distintivo."""
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    
    # Fila 1: etiqueta
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    
    # Fila 2: prompt
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    
    doc.add_paragraph()  # espaciado

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    """Añade bloque 'Dora de oro' (consejo valioso)."""
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    """Añade bloque de error común."""
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    """Añade salto de página."""
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    """Crea documento con configuración base."""
    doc = Document()
    
    # Configurar márgenes A4
    sections = doc.sections
    for section in sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    """Construye portada del curso."""
    # Espacio inicial
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    
    # Título principal
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    
    # Subtítulo
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    
    # Descripción
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])

from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Cm, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURACIÓN BASE
# ============================================================
base_dir = '/home/workspace/manos_abiertas_cursos'
os.makedirs(f'{base_dir}/download', exist_ok=True)

PALETA = {
    "primario": "C75B3C", "secundario": "6B7A3A", "acento": "D9A441",
    "fondo": "FAF3E7", "fondo_oscuro": "2B2A28", "texto": "1F1B16",
    "texto_claro": "5C544A", "borde": "D8C7A8", "blanco": "FFFFFF",
    "pista": "EFE3CC", "aviso": "F4D9CE"
}

def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color_hex)
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    tc_pr.append(shd)

def set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex="000000", size="4"):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tc_borders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
    for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
        border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
        border.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        border.set(qn("w:sz"), size)
        border.set(qn("w:color"), color_hex)
        tc_borders.append(border)
    tc_pr.append(tc_borders)

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    elif level == 3:
        run.font.size = Pt(12)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=120, after=60)
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo de este módulo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)

    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

Estoy consolidando todas las funciones auxiliares necesarias para el procesamiento de datos en un solo entorno operativo.

{"code": "import os
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Cm, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURACIÓN BASE
# ============================================================
base_dir = '/home/workspace/manos_abiertas_cursos'
os.makedirs(f'{base_dir}/download', exist_ok=True)

PALETA = {
    "primario": "C75B3C", "secundario": "6B7A3A", "acento": "D9A441",
    "fondo": "FAF3E7", "fondo_oscuro": "2B2A28", "texto": "1F1B16",
    "texto_claro": "5C544A", "borde": "D8C7A8", "blanco": "FFFFFF",
    "pista": "EFE3CC", "aviso": "F4D9CE"
}

def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color_hex)
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    tc_pr.append(shd)

def set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex="000000", size="4"):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tc_borders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
    for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
        border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
        border.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        border.set(qn("w:sz"), size)
        border.set(qn("w:color"), color_hex)
        tc_borders.append(border)
    tc_pr.append(tc_borders)

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo de este módulo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

def generate_course(course_name, subtitle, description, modules, output_file):
    """Genera un curso completo."""
    doc = setup_document()
    build_cover(doc, course_name, subtitle, description)
    build_toc(doc, modules)
    for module in modules:
        build_module(doc, module)
    
    output_path = f'{base_dir}/download/{output_file}'
    doc.save(output_path)
    print(f"✓ Generado: {output_file} ({os.path.getsize(output_path)/1024:.1f} KB)")
    return output_path

print("✓ Sistema de generación listo")
"}

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo de este módulo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

def generate_course(course_name, subtitle, description, modules, output_file):
    doc = setup_document()
    build_cover(doc, course_name, subtitle, description)
    build_toc(doc, modules)
    for module in modules:
        build_module(doc, module)
    output_path = f'{base_dir}/download/{output_file}'
    doc.save(output_path)
    print(f"✓ Generado: {output_file} ({os.path.getsize(output_path)/1024:.1f} KB)")

# Configuración
base_dir = '/home/workspace/manos_abiertas_cursos'
os.makedirs(f'{base_dir}/download', exist_ok=True)

PALETA = {
    "primario": "C75B3C", "secundario": "6B7A3A", "acento": "D9A441",
    "fondo": "FAF3E7", "fondo_oscuro": "2B2A28", "texto": "1F1B16",
    "texto_claro": "5C544A", "borde": "D8C7A8", "blanco": "FFFFFF",
    "pista": "EFE3CC", "aviso": "F4D9CE"
}

# Funciones helper (compactas)
def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color_hex)
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    tc_pr.append(shd)

def set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex="000000", size="4"):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tc_borders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
    for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
        border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
        border.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        border.set(qn("w:sz"), size)
        border.set(qn("w:color"), color_hex)
        tc_borders.append(border)
    tc_pr.append(tc_borders)

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

def generate_course(course_name, subtitle, description, modules, output_file):
    doc = setup_document()
    build_cover(doc, course_name, subtitle, description)
    build_toc(doc, modules)
    for module in modules:
        build_module(doc, module)
    output_path = f'{base_dir}/download/{output_file}'
    doc.save(output_path)
    size = os.path.getsize(output_path) / 1024
    print(f"✓ {output_file} ({size:.1f} KB)")
    return output_path

print("✓ Sistema listo. Generando 8 cursos...")
"}

    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

def generate_course(course_name, subtitle, description, modules, output_file):
    """Genera un curso completo."""
    doc = setup_document()
    build_cover(doc, course_name, subtitle, description)
    build_toc(doc, modules)
    for module in modules:
        build_module(doc, module)
    
    # Guardar en el directorio correcto
    output_path = os.path.join(download_dir, output_file)
    doc.save(output_path)
    size = os.path.getsize(output_path) / 1024
    print(f"✓ {output_file} ({size:.1f} KB)")
    return output_path

{"code": "cursos_lib_content = '''"""
Librería común para generar los cursos de Manos Abiertas.
Plantilla docx con paleta cálida, estilos consistentes y helpers reutilizables.
"""
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Cm, RGBColor, Inches, Emu
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_LINE_SPACING, WD_BREAK
from docx.enum.table import WD_ALIGN_VERTICAL, WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
import copy

# ============================================================
# Paleta Manos Abiertas — tono cálido comunitario
# ============================================================
PALETA = {
    "primario":    "C75B3C",  # terracota (color principal Manos Abiertas)
    "secundario":  "6B7A3A",  # verde oliva (apoyo)
    "acento":      "D9A441",  # ámbar dorado (highlights)
    "fondo":       "FAF3E7",  # crema claro (cajas)
    "fondo_oscuro":"2B2A28",  # carbón (texto fuerte)
    "texto":       "1F1B16",  # marrón oscuro (cuerpo)
    "texto_claro": "5C544A",  # gris cálido (metadata)
    "borde":       "D8C7A8",  # beige borde (cajas suaves)
    "blanco":      "FFFFFF",
    "pista":       "EFE3CC",  # crema oscuro (fondo dora)
    "aviso":       "F4D9CE",  # melocotón claro (fondo error)
}

# ============================================================
# Helpers de bajo nivel (XML)
# ============================================================
def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex):
    """Aplica color de fondo a una celda."""
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color_hex)
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    tc_pr.append(shd)

def set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex="000000", size="4"):
    """Aplica bordes a una celda."""
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tc_borders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
    for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
        border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
        border.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        border.set(qn("w:sz"), size)
        border.set(qn("w:color"), color_hex)
        tc_borders.append(border)
    tc_pr.append(tc_borders)

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    """Configura espaciado de párrafo."""
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

# ============================================================
# Helpers de contenido
# ============================================================
def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    """Añade un título con estilo consistente."""
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    elif level == 3:
        run.font.size = Pt(12)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=120, after=60)
    
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    """Añade párrafo de texto."""
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    """Añade un bloque de prompt con estilo visual distintivo."""
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    
    # Fila 1: etiqueta
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    
    # Fila 2: prompt
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    
    doc.add_paragraph()  # espaciado

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    """Añade bloque 'Dora de oro' (consejo valioso)."""
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    """Añade bloque de error común."""
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    """Añade salto de página."""
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    """Crea documento con configuración base."""
    doc = Document()
    
    # Configurar márgenes A4
    sections = doc.sections
    for section in sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    """Construye portada del curso."""
    # Espacio inicial
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    
    # Título principal
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    
    # Subtítulo
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    
    # Descripción
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    
    # Espacio final
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    
    # Footer
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    """Construye un módulo completo."""
    # Título del módulo
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    
    # Objetivo
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo de este módulo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    
    # Concepto clave
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    
    # Paso a paso
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    
    # Ejercicio práctico
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    
    # Dora de oro
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    
    # Error común
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    """Construye tabla de contenidos."""
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    
    add_page_break(doc)

def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color_hex)
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    tc_pr.append(shd)

def set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex="000000", size="4"):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tc_borders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
    for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
        border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
        border.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        border.set(qn("w:sz"), size)
        border.set(qn("w:color"), color_hex)
        tc_borders.append(border)
    tc_pr.append(tc_borders)

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    elif level == 3:
        run.font.size = Pt(12)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=120, after=60)
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)

    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_dora_block(doc, text):

    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):

    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]

    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)

    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo de este módulo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

print("✓ Funciones helper definidas")

{"code": "import os
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Cm, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURACIÓN BASE
# ============================================================
base_dir = '/home/workspace/manos_abiertas_cursos'
os.makedirs(f'{base_dir}/download', exist_ok=True)

PALETA = {
    "primario": "C75B3C", "secundario": "6B7A3A", "acento": "D9A441",
    "fondo": "FAF3E7", "fondo_oscuro": "2B2A28", "texto": "1F1B16",
    "texto_claro": "5C544A", "borde": "D8C7A8", "blanco": "FFFFFF",
    "pista": "EFE3CC", "aviso": "F4D9CE"
}

def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color_hex)
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    tc_pr.append(shd)

def set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex="000000", size="4"):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tc_borders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
    for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
        border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
        border.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        border.set(qn("w:sz"), size)
        border.set(qn("w:color"), color_hex)
        tc_borders.append(border)
    tc_pr.append(tc_borders)

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo de este módulo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

def generate_course(course_name, subtitle, description, modules, output_file):
    """Genera un curso completo."""
    doc = setup_document()
    build_cover(doc, course_name, subtitle, description)
    build_toc(doc, modules)
    for module in modules:
        build_module(doc, module)
    
    output_path = f'{base_dir}/download/{output_file}'
    doc.save(output_path)
    print(f"✓ Generado: {output_file} ({os.path.getsize(output_path)/1024:.1f} KB)")
    return output_path

print("✓ Sistema de generación listo")
"}

    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])

    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])

def build_toc(doc, modules):

    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

def generate_course(course_name, subtitle, description, modules, output_file):
    doc = setup_document()
    build_cover(doc, course_name, subtitle, description)
    build_toc(doc, modules)
    for module in modules:
        build_module(doc, module)
    output_path = f'{base_dir}/download/{output_file}'
    doc.save(output_path)
    print(f"✓ Generado: {output_file} ({os.path.getsize(output_path)/1024:.1f} KB)")
    return output_path

{"code": "import os
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Cm, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

# Configuración
base_dir = '/home/workspace/manos_abiertas_cursos'
os.makedirs(f'{base_dir}/download', exist_ok=True)

PALETA = {
    "primario": "C75B3C", "secundario": "6B7A3A", "acento": "D9A441",
    "fondo": "FAF3E7", "fondo_oscuro": "2B2A28", "texto": "1F1B16",
    "texto_claro": "5C544A", "borde": "D8C7A8", "blanco": "FFFFFF",
    "pista": "EFE3CC", "aviso": "F4D9CE"
}

# Funciones helper (compactas)
def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), color_hex)
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    tc_pr.append(shd)

def set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex="000000", size="4"):
    tc_pr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tc_borders = OxmlElement("w:tcBorders")
    for border_name in ["top", "left", "bottom", "right"]:
        border = OxmlElement(f"w:{border_name}")
        border.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        border.set(qn("w:sz"), size)
        border.set(qn("w:color"), color_hex)
        tc_borders.append(border)
    tc_pr.append(tc_borders)

def set_paragraph_spacing(paragraph, before=0, after=0, line=276):
    p_pr = paragraph._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    spacing = OxmlElement("w:spacing")
    spacing.set(qn("w:before"), str(before))
    spacing.set(qn("w:after"), str(after))
    spacing.set(qn("w:line"), str(line))
    spacing.set(qn("w:lineRule"), "auto")
    p_pr.append(spacing)

def add_heading(doc, text, level=1):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    if level == 1:
        run.font.size = Pt(18)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=240, after=120)
    elif level == 2:
        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

def generate_course(course_name, subtitle, description, modules, output_file):
    doc = setup_document()
    build_cover(doc, course_name, subtitle, description)
    build_toc(doc, modules)
    for module in modules:
        build_module(doc, module)
    output_path = f'{base_dir}/download/{output_file}'
    doc.save(output_path)
    size = os.path.getsize(output_path) / 1024
    print(f"✓ {output_file} ({size:.1f} KB)")
    return output_path

print("✓ Sistema listo. Generando 8 cursos...")
"}

        run.font.size = Pt(14)
        run.font.bold = True
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=180, after=80)
    return p

def add_text(doc, text, bold=False, color=None, size=11):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run(text)
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(color if color else PALETA["texto"])
    if bold:
        run.font.bold = True
    set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=0, after=60, line=312)
    return p

def add_prompt_block(doc, label, prompt):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=2, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell_label = table.cell(0, 0)
    cell_label.text = label
    p_label = cell_label.paragraphs[0]
    p_label.runs[0].font.bold = True
    p_label.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    p_label.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    set_cell_shading(cell_label, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_label, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    cell_prompt = table.cell(1, 0)
    cell_prompt.text = prompt
    p_prompt = cell_prompt.paragraphs[0]
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.name = "Courier New"
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.size = Pt(10)
    p_prompt.runs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["blanco"])
    set_cell_shading(cell_prompt, PALETA["fondo_oscuro"])
    set_cell_borders(cell_prompt, color_hex=PALETA["fondo_oscuro"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_dora_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("💎 Dora de oro: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["acento"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["pista"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["acento"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_error_block(doc, text):
    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    table.style = 'Table Grid'
    cell = table.cell(0, 0)
    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    run1 = p.add_run("⚠️ Error común: ")
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    run1.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2 = p.add_run(text)
    run2.font.size = Pt(10)
    run2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
    set_cell_shading(cell, PALETA["aviso"])
    set_cell_borders(cell, color_hex=PALETA["primario"], size="4")
    doc.add_paragraph()

def add_page_break(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    run = p.add_run("")
    run.add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)

def setup_document():
    doc = Document()
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.bottom_margin = Cm(2.0)
        section.left_margin = Cm(2.5)
        section.right_margin = Cm(2.5)
    return doc

def build_cover(doc, title, subtitle, description):
    for _ in range(3):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_title = p_title.add_run(title)
    run_title.font.size = Pt(28)
    run_title.font.bold = True
    run_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["primario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_title, before=0, after=160, line=720)
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(subtitle)
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(16)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["secundario"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_sub, before=0, after=240, line=360)
    p_desc = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_desc.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_desc = p_desc.add_run(description)
    run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_desc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    set_paragraph_spacing(p_desc, before=0, after=0, line=312)
    for _ in range(5):
        doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_footer.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    run_footer = p_footer.add_run("Manos Abiertas · NOIACORE")
    run_footer.font.size = Pt(9)
    run_footer.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto_claro"])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_module(doc, module_data):
    add_heading(doc, module_data['title'], level=1)
    add_heading(doc, "🎯 Objetivo", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['objective'])
    add_heading(doc, "💡 Concepto clave", level=2)
    add_text(doc, module_data['concept'])
    add_heading(doc, "📋 Paso a paso", level=2)
    for step in module_data['steps']:
        add_text(doc, step)
    add_heading(doc, "🔧 Ejercicio práctico", level=2)
    add_prompt_block(doc, module_data['ejercicio_label'], module_data['ejercicio_prompt'])
    add_dora_block(doc, module_data['dora'])
    add_error_block(doc, module_data['error'])
    add_page_break(doc)

def build_toc(doc, modules):
    add_heading(doc, "📚 Contenido del curso", level=1)
    for i, mod in enumerate(modules):
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(f"Módulo {i}: {mod['title']}")
        run.font.size = Pt(11)
        run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor.from_string(PALETA["texto"])
        set_paragraph_spacing(p, before=60, after=60)
    add_page_break(doc)

def generate_course(course_name, subtitle, description, modules, output_file):
    """Genera un curso completo."""
    doc = setup_document()
    build_cover(doc, course_name, subtitle, description)
    build_toc(doc, modules)
    for module in modules:
        build_module(doc, module)
    
    # Guardar en el directorio correcto
    output_path = os.path.join(download_dir, output_file)
    doc.save(output_path)
    size = os.path.getsize(output_path) / 1024
    print(f"✓ {output_file} ({size:.1f} KB)")
    return output_path

print("✓ Sistema listo para generar cursos 5-8")
"}
